title: A project's icon change shows everywhere in the app at once, without a relaunch

requirements.text: Editing projects.json from outside the app (another session changing a project's icon) updates every icon view in the running app within a couple of seconds
requirements.check: eye: change an icon entry in projects.json by hand; dashboard card, tab and inspector icons change without relaunch

requirements.text: Replacing an icon image file in place (same path) redraws the icon without a relaunch
requirements.check: eye: overwrite the png/svg at the stored path; the icon redraws

requirements.text: The app's own saves do not loop or clobber outside edits made to other fields
requirements.check: manual: ProjectStore reload test in swift test passes

evidence: testARunningAppPicksUpAnIconChangedByAnotherSession passes: reload of own save=false, other session's emoji icon picked up with tier kept, unreadable file changes nothing
swift build complete; swift test 127 tests, 0 failures

text: Done without AppModel: ProjectStore.reload()/isStoreChange, ProjectWatcher relevant: filter, IconFiles revision in ProjectIconViews (image replaced in place redraws), started in GenlockApp after boot. 127 tests pass. Left: AppModel hookup so projects.json edits reload the store (AppModel.swift held by T-3S3WS; note left). Not committed.

evidence: Built app driven on scratch store: external edit of projects.json set proj2 icon to emoji; driver report r1 proj2 icon '' -> r2 'emoji(🎯)'; snapshot card header P initial -> 🎯 without relaunch
Overwrote store/icons/a.png red->blue at same path while running: IconFiles revision 0 -> 1, snapshot card icon red -> blue
after AppModel hookup + /private path fix: swift build complete, swift test 127 tests 0 failures

text: Done and verified live on scratch store. AppModel watches projects.json (reloadStore), IconFiles redraws on icon file change, paths compared via ProjectStore.comparable (/private/tmp quirk). Driver report gains icon + iconRevision. Not committed; TJ must relaunch the installed app to get it.

answers.observed: driver reports r1/r2 and snapshots c1/c3 in scratchpad/live: proj2 icon '' -> emoji(🎯), proj icon red -> blue, iconRevision 0->1, with no relaunch
answers.cause: measured: first live run showed no change; filters compared /tmp (Foundation resolve) vs /private/tmp (FSEvents); normalizing fixed it, re-run showed both changes
answers.absence: verified on a scratch store under /private/tmp, not on ~/Library/Application Support/Genlock in the installed app; that path has no symlink so the same filter applies, but TJ's relaunch is the real check
answers.assumption: mine: icons change from outside the app (another session, file swap). In-app picker path already updated via observation and is unchanged
answers.falsify: after relaunch, edit an icon in ~/Library/Application Support/Genlock/projects.json; if the dashboard card does not change within ~2s, this is wrong
